svg.title: Figure 4-2: side elevation, the scan plane against low objects and the CFG-002 envelope, workspace and keep-clear
svg.desc: Two panels. A: the base in side view with the 0.222 m and 0.18 m scan planes drawn as dashed lines ahead of it over a translucent band up to the 0.3 m detection height; a 0.15 m carton, a 0.3 m carton, a foot and a crawling child on the floor, each labelled seen, unseen or marginal. B: the 2.0 manipulator with the lift extended, the arm profile and head camera, a reaching arm, the 0.6 m reach arc, the 1.08 m workspace boundary as a vertical dashed line with a person standing at it, the 1.7 m envelope line and the 0.55 m keep-clear bar on the floor.
